observations.body: Women find the stone rolled away and the body absent, hear two men recall Jesus’ prediction, remember, report to the apostles, and Peter runs to the tomb.
observations.label: Women remember the saying; apostles call the report nonsense

payload.posture: Read Luke 24:1–12 as one movement in the resurrection, keeping the passage's actions, setting, sequence, and limits visible.
payload.tension: The passage states women find the stone rolled away and the body absent, hear two men recall Jesus’ prediction, remember, report to the apostles, and Peter runs to the tomb. It does not by itself supply every cause or later interpretation of this part of the resurrection.
payload.title: Women remember the saying; apostles call the report nonsense
